author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 
GO:0019283 L-methionine biosynthetic process from L-homoserine via O-phospho-L-homoserine and cystathionine
GO:0019280 L-methionine biosynthetic process from L-homoserine via O-acetyl-L-homoserine
GO:0019279 L-methionine biosynthetic process from L-homoserine via cystathionine

& replace by parent [L-methionine biosynthetic process](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0071265). 

There are 4 annotations, including 1 extension to these terms, see https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uBc36q7KyPwVWDQl6J52YIHvReskp4oBy-AQpZN6A6U/edit?gid=0#gid=0

~2 pombase (1 annot + 1 extension)~ fixed
- 1 MTBBASE
- 1 ASPGD
